title: Cargo
description: Runs cargo commands from a workspace root, one process per command for every selected package, each task decided by its own package's report

cwd.description: Cargo workspace root, relative to the Nx workspace root

package.description: Package the task selects, passed to cargo as a package ID spec

commands.description: Cargo invocations in order, a task stopping at its first failure

trailing.description: Arguments after --, passed on to the compiler run

packages.description: Packages the command selects beside each task's own, each by its folder relative to the Nx workspace root and its name

report.description: What decides each task: cargo's JSON messages (`messages`), nextest's per-suite results (`tests`), or the exit status alone (`status`)

args.description: Arguments after -- appended to every command

outputs.description: Files the commands write, each folder created before the run
